causal_findings.scope: Static source analysis, not Windows execution. The predecessor creates and writes a regular file before its final parent File::open(parent)?.sync_all(). A later directory-handle failure can therefore leave an artifact or temporary file; no original Windows artifact residue was captured.
The predecessor opens or creates a lock file, but exclusive flock is cfg(unix) only. Non-Unix regular-file checks do not establish an exclusive directory owner.

Non-Unix private mode verification returns Ok and parent identity is directory-kind-only. Windows FileSnapshot protects regular-file identity, reparse and hardlink checks; it does not qualify private directory ACL ownership, held-root durable binding or an exclusive sidecar lock.

public_reachability.g5_prepare: prepare_g5_challenge validates portable inputs and calls write_private_new without the V1 formal Mac host guard. With valid pinned inputs the mutation seam is statically reachable; it was not executed on Windows in this review.
public_reachability.g5_assess: assess_g5_challenge with Some(assessment_path) calls write_private_new. None remains read-only and grants no authority.
public_reachability.v1: prepare, verify_and_seal and verify_receipt require exact formal environment and canonical /Volumes/T5 V1 roots before the helper seam. Original internal helper failures do not prove public V1 Windows side effects.

minimal_repair.non_unix_result: AcceptanceError::UnsupportedPrivateDirectoryOwner before any helper create/write/rename/lock side effect; no successful fallback or ignored flush error.
minimal_repair.unix_result: Guard returns Ok without I/O, preserving the existing body and error order.
minimal_repair.read_scope: secure_read, secure_hash and canonical/hash APIs are unchanged. High-level verify_receipt requests lock_existing_sidecar and thus also inherits the intended unsupported-owner lock refusal on non-Unix.
minimal_repair.api_scope: AcceptanceError adds a public variant. Repository explicit variant consumers were reviewed; external exhaustive consumers may need to handle the new variant.
minimal_repair.not_a_windows_backend: No Windows owner, ACL qualification, directory flush qualification, power-loss proof, successful private writer or exclusive lock backend is implemented.

new_windows_native_negative_tests.assertion_scope: Actual helper calls must return the exact typed refusal and preserve the complete fixture directory listing, file bytes, created/modified times and read-only flags. No target, temporary or new lock file may appear. These are selected seam negatives, not public Windows positive acceptance.
new_windows_native_negative_tests.execution: NOT_RUN locally; the module is compiled and executed only on actual Windows. No platform spoofing or synthetic Windows acceptance.

specific_shard3.scope: Original SSH fixture NotFound and private helper PermissionDenied are retained. PermissionDenied log lacks syscall-stage and resulting filesystem snapshots; it is not proof of observed leftover artifacts.

directory_probe.scope: Held-root read/write directory FlushFileBuffers and NtFlushBuffersFileEx probes succeeded, while owner_supported and power_loss_qualified remained false. This repair does not claim Windows cannot flush a directory; the product private directory owner is unqualified.
